relationships.subject: BAY 59-3074
relationships.evidence_quote: is a CNS active partial agonist of both human and rat CB1 and CB2 receptors based on this chemotype [10]

relationships.subject: sulfamide 21
relationships.evidence_quote: Of significance, the cyclohexylsulfamide 21 is a partial agonist in the cAMP hCB1 assay (EC50 ~140 nM, 27%).

relationships.subject: benzylamide 24
relationships.evidence_quote: The benzylamide 24, however, was a good partial agonist in the cAMP hCB1 assay (~370 nM, 36%).

key_findings: Sulfonamide analogs of BAY 59-3074 were full hCB1 agonists, whereas sulfamide 21 and benzylamide 24 were hCB1 partial agonists.
Compound 21 had vastly reduced brain penetration (brain:plasma Cmax ratio 0.17) versus BAY 59-3074 (0.40).
